name: Mongolosaurus
sum: Mongolosaurus is a titanosauriform sauropod from the Early Cretaceous On Gong Formation of Inner Mongolia, China, known from teeth and skull and neck fragments.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: AMNH 6710, with teeth, a basioccipital and parts of the first three cervical vertebrae.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Gilmore 1933
